Premium A5 Notepad & Branded Diaries | Corporate Gifts Notebook With Logo

Upgrade your corporate gifting experience with our Premium A5 Notepad & Branded Diaries, designed especially for companies looking to deliver elegant, functional, and high-quality branded stationery. This Corporate Gifts Notebook With Logo is crafted with a modern Classic PU Notebook with Magnet Lock, making it a perfect choice for employee welcome kits, business events, conferences, brand promotions, and executive gifting.

The refined design features a premium PU hardbound cover with a stylish magnetic flap that also includes a Gunmetal plate on lock. This plate can be laser engraved with your logo, ensuring long-lasting, professional brand visibility. Whether you run a corporate office, gifting agency, advertising company, or HR department, this A5 diary adds value as a practical, elegant, and memorable corporate gift.

Inside, the diary contains a total of 176 high-quality writing pages that support smooth daily writing, planning, note-taking, and task management. It includes a built-in personal memorandum, planner section, bookmark ribbon, and neatly printed inner layouts — ideal for professionals, managers, and students. The A5 size makes it lightweight, travel-friendly, and easy to carry inside backpacks, laptop bags, and office folders.

Why Choose Our Premium A5 Notepad & Branded Corporate Diaries?

In the world of corporate gifts and customized office stationery, companies prefer items that are useful, durable, and visually impressive. This corporate diary with logo aligns with all those needs. Its classic PU finish enhances brand impression, while the magnet lock keeps the pages secure.

Whether you are looking to distribute them during festive gifting, promotional campaigns, client meetings, or annual events, this branded corporate diary elevates your gifting standards and strengthens brand recall.
